column1: # Signed-in SaaS starter scan (.github/workflows/dast-zap.yml). ZAP sends the session cookie
# of a disposable account with every request, so the spider can submit the starter's forms.
# The POST-only commands below are out of scope: signing out everywhere revokes the session
# the scan runs with, and checkout/portal open a billing-provider session. GET has no
# handler on these paths, so no page leaves the scan. Every other alert stays live.

column3: (Double-submit CSRF cookie is intentionally readable and remains Secure/SameSite)
(A re-rendered form's _token is the server-issued CSRF cookie value the middleware already matched, never attacker input)
(Dynamic responses intentionally default to explicit Cache-Control no-store)
(Cryptographically random CSRF and CSP nonce values are expected encoded tokens)
(The public sign-in POST is intentionally recognized as an authentication request)
(CSRF cookie correctly identifies a state-management response)
(ZAP is not a browser and does not send browser-authored Sec-Fetch request headers)
